Source According to sources, the budget of Ranabaali is reportedly Rs 150 crore plus. "It has to garner more collections and needs to touch a Rs 50 crore share in theatres. It has managed around Rs 30 crore and needs more footfalls," says a distributor.
 He says that the Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika combination was a crowd puller, but that is not enough. "Its non-theatrical rights fetched Rs 70 crore for the production house, so the rest has to be recovered in theatres and through music rights. However, it has a long way to go to break even. With theatrical collections dropping to Rs 3 crore a day, it is not enough," he points out.
 Another version is that the British-era action adventure was wrapped up in Rs 120 crore, so the producers (Naveen Yerneni and Y Ravi Shankar) are on the safe side. "We have to wait for the final collections report to know whether it recovered its big investment. Riding on the confidence given by director Rahul Sankrityan, they invested heavily. They thought it would work in other languages, but it did not happen as they expected," he concludes.
